title_en: The Phone at the Skewer Stall
note_en: The pair 一边…一边… means two actions happen at the same time: 一边翻烤串，一边跟手机里的人聊天 "(Lao Liao) turns the skewers while chatting with the people on the phone." Each 一边 goes right before its own verb. In English, "while" or an -ing phrase often works: 女儿一边帮他收钱，一边念弹幕 "taking the money for him, his daughter read out the comments."
